subject.title: fix(infra): keep system-agent approval text UTF-16 safe at truncation boundary

question: Should this external PR provide a real system-agent approval run, or should maintainers explicitly override the real-behavior-proof gate because the transformation is a pure deterministic string boundary fix?
rationale: Repository policy requires real after-fix behavior proof for external non-docs PRs, while the contributor argues that deterministic pre-fix/post-fix regression coverage fully proves this pure projection helper.

options.title: Require live approval proof
options.body: Hold merge until a real system-agent approval produces redacted reviewer-facing output showing the title or description remains well-formed at the surrogate boundary.

options.title: Apply proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the deterministic regression evidence and mark proof overridden if a live system-agent setup is disproportionate for this pure string transformation.

recommendation.title: Require live approval proof
recommendation.body: Hold merge until a real system-agent approval produces redacted reviewer-facing output showing the title or description remains well-formed at the surrogate boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work demonstrates the strongest available involvement with durable approval presentation and decision behavior.
